  "description": "St. Dominic Catholic Hospital is a 64-bed hospital located in Ogungbade off New Ife road in Ibadan. St. Dominic Catholic Hospital is the vision of the Dominican Sisters of St. Catherine of Siena (Italy). We offer various medical services such as: General medicine, internal medicine, O &amp; G, Laboratory, and Radiology, to mention just a few. The hospital is run in collaboration with foreign partners. We are registered and licensed by the Corporate Affairs Commission and the Ministry of Health. Also, we are accredited by the NHIS as both primary and secondary health care providers.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: HMO Officer
Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose


	The HMO Officer is responsible for managing all Health Maintenance Organization related operations in the hospital. The role ensures smooth enrollment, authorization, claims processing, and relationship management between the hospital, HMOs, and patients to guarantee prompt service delivery and revenue collection.


Responsibilities
Patient Services &amp; Eligibility:


	Verify HMO patient eligibility and coverage using HMO portals before consultation/admission.
	Ensure proper registration and issuance of authorization codes for all HMO enrollees.
	Attend to HMO patients&rsquo; complaints and guide them on benefits, co-pay, and exclusions.
	Liaise with clinicians to ensure treatment plans fall within HMO package guidelines.


Authorization &amp; Claims Management:


	Obtain pre-authorization for consultations, admissions, surgeries, and referrals within stipulated time.
	Prepare, collate, and submit claims to respective HMOs with complete supporting documents.
	Follow up on outstanding claims and ensure timely payment/reimbursement by HMOs.
	Track and reconcile HMO payments and deductions with hospital finance.


HMO Relations &amp; Compliance:


	Serve as the primary liaison between the hospital and all partner HMOs: AXA Mansard, Hygeia, Redcare, Avon, etc.
	Ensure the hospital complies with NHIA/HMO guidelines, service level agreements, and tariff structures.
	Attend HMO meetings, trainings, and audits on behalf of the hospital.
	Communicate policy changes, new tariffs, and benefit updates to clinical staff.


Reporting &amp; Documentation


	Maintain an accurate database of all HMO patients, authorizations, and claims.
	Prepare weekly/monthly reports on HMO patient volume, revenue, outstanding claims, and challenges.
	Ensure proper filing and archiving of all HMO documents for audit purposes.


Requirements


	Education: HND/Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Health Administration, finance, Nursing, Public Health, or related fields.
	Experience: 2-3 years of experience in an HMO, Hospital Corporate Services, or Insurance department.
	Knowledge: Good understanding of NHIA guidelines, HMO operations, and hospital billing processes.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and HMO portals
	Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills
	Attention to detail and good record-keeping
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Professionalism and patient-centered approach.


Salary
N90,000 - N130,000 per month.&nbsp;

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Application Letter to: adm.sdchib2019@yahoo.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

HMO Officer Job at St. Dominic Catholic Hospital




        
    

        
        St. Dominic Catholic Hospital is a 64-bed hospital located in Ogungbade off New Ife road in Ibadan. St. Dominic Catholic Hospital is the vision of the Dominican Sisters of St. Catherine of Siena (Italy). We offer various medical services such as: General medicine, internal medicine, O & G, Laboratory, and Radiology, to mention just a few. The hospital is run in collaboration with foreign partners. We are registered and licensed by the Corporate Affairs Commission and the Ministry of Health. Also, we are accredited by the NHIS as both primary and secondary health care providers.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HMO Officer
Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose


	The HMO Officer is responsible for managing all Health Maintenance Organization related operations in the hospital. The role ensures smooth enrollment, authorization, claims processing, and relationship management between the hospital, HMOs, and patients to guarantee prompt service delivery and revenue collection.


Responsibilities
Patient Services & Eligibility:


	Verify HMO patient eligibility and coverage using HMO portals before consultation/admission.
	Ensure proper registration and issuance of authorization codes for all HMO enrollees.
	Attend to HMO patients’ complaints and guide them on benefits, co-pay, and exclusions.
	Liaise with clinicians to ensure treatment plans fall within HMO package guidelines.


Authorization & Claims Management:


	Obtain pre-authorization for consultations, admissions, surgeries, and referrals within stipulated time.
	Prepare, collate, and submit claims to respective HMOs with complete supporting documents.
	Follow up on outstanding claims and ensure timely payment/reimbursement by HMOs.
	Track and reconcile HMO payments and deductions with hospital finance.


HMO Relations & Compliance:


	Serve as the primary liaison between the hospital and all partner HMOs: AXA Mansard, Hygeia, Redcare, Avon, etc.
	Ensure the hospital complies with NHIA/HMO guidelines, service level agreements, and tariff structures.
	Attend HMO meetings, trainings, and audits on behalf of the hospital.
	Communicate policy changes, new tariffs, and benefit updates to clinical staff.


Reporting & Documentation


	Maintain an accurate database of all HMO patients, authorizations, and claims.
	Prepare weekly/monthly reports on HMO patient volume, revenue, outstanding claims, and challenges.
	Ensure proper filing and archiving of all HMO documents for audit purposes.


Requirements


	Education: HND/Bachelor’s Degree in Health Administration, finance, Nursing, Public Health, or related fields.
	Experience: 2-3 years of experience in an HMO, Hospital Corporate Services, or Insurance department.
	Knowledge: Good understanding of NHIA guidelines, HMO operations, and hospital billing processes.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and HMO portals
	Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills
	Attention to detail and good record-keeping
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Professionalism and patient-centered approach.


Salary
N90,000 - N130,000 per month. 

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Application Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Fort Hermon Limited is a dynamic engineering and construction company specializing in delivering high-quality infrastructure, building, and industrial projects. With a focus on innovation, safety, and technical excellence, we provide end-to-end solutions that meet global standards and exceed client expectations.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: HSE Officer (Construction Project Site)
Job Location: Minna, Niger
Employment Type: Contract
Industry: Construction &amp; Engineering

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and experienced Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Officer to join our project team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining Health, Safety and Environmental policies and procedures to ensure compliance with company standards and statutory regulations.
	The successful candidate must have proven experience working on construction project sites and possess a strong commitment to promoting a safe and healthy work environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Implement and enforce the company&#39;s Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) policies and procedures on the project site.
	Conduct daily site safety inspections and identify potential hazards, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
	Ensure compliance with all applicable HSE regulations, client requirements, and industry standards.
	Facilitate site safety inductions for all employees, subcontractors, and visitors.
	Conduct regular toolbox talks, safety briefings, and HSE awareness training.
	Monitor work activities to ensure compliance with safe work practices and the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
	Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, preparing comprehensive reports and recommendations.
	Develop and implement emergency response procedures and coordinate emergency drills.
	Maintain HSE documentation, including inspection reports, incident reports, permits, risk assessments, and training records.
	Conduct Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) and Risk Assessments before high-risk activities commence.
	Monitor environmental compliance, including waste management, pollution prevention, and housekeeping standards.
	Liaise with regulatory authorities, clients, consultants, and management on HSE-related matters.
	Monitor subcontractor HSE performance and ensure compliance with project safety requirements.
	Prepare weekly and monthly HSE performance reports for management.
	Promote a strong safety culture across the project through continuous engagement and coaching.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health &amp; Safety, or a related discipline.
	3&ndash;5 years of HSE experience on construction project sites.
	Professional HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, ISPON, OSHA, IOSH, or equivalent are required.
	Sound knowledge of Nigerian HSE regulations and construction safety standards.
	Experience conducting incident investigations, risk assessments, and safety audits.
	Strong knowledge of permit-to-work systems and safe work procedures.
	Excellent report writing, communication, and presentation skills.
	Strong leadership, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
	Ability to work under pressure and in remote project site locations.


Preferred Competencies:


	Strong attention to detail.
	High level of integrity and professionalism.
	Excellent observation and hazard identification skills.
	Ability to influence safe behaviours across all workforce levels.
	Good decision-making and conflict resolution skills.
	Strong organisational and time management abilities.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Inetersted and qualified candidates should send their CV to: vineonyido@gmail.com using &quot;HSE Officer - Niger as the subject of the email.",

{

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "I.T Manager",
  "description": "Cheaper Beta Enterprises is fast growing company with focus to provide consumers goods and services at the best market price . We are continually creating an atmosphere for employees to grow.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: I.T Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We&#39;re looking for a proactive, solution-oriented professional who can drive technology efficiency and support business growth with experience in the Aviation, Construction and Real estate sector.
	The IT Manager will oversee and manage IT infrastructure, systems and technology operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the company&#39;s IT infrastructure, networks and systems.
	Ensure the security, availability and performance of IT resources.
	Provide technical support and troubleshoot hardware, software and network issues.
	Manage IT vendors, software licences and technology assets.
	Recommend and implement technology solutions to improve business operations.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree/HND in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of experience in IT operations, with proven leadership or management responsibility.
	Experience working within the Aviation, Construction, Real Estate, or related industries is highly preferred.
	Strong knowledge of network administration, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and systems management.
	Proven experience managing hardware, software, servers, networks, and other IT assets.
	Knowledge of cloud solutions, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365, and data backup/recovery systems is an advantage.
	Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
	Experience managing IT vendors, software licences, budgets, and technology procurement.
	Strong understanding of IT security, access controls, data protection, and business continuity.
	Excellent problem-solving, communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
	Ability to recommend and implement technology solutions that improve efficiency and support business growth.
	Relevant professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA, Microsoft, ITIL, CISSP, or related certifications will be an added advantage.
	Must be proactive, solution-oriented, organized, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.


Other Requirements:


	IT experience with leadership or management responsibility.
	Strong knowledge of network administration, cybersecurity and IT systems management.
	Experience managing cloud solutions and enterprise applications is an advantage.
	Excellent problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
